description: This file contains helper functions for integrating and processing Twitter data within a PHP application, including functions for checking module enablement, formatting tweets, replacing hashtags and user mentions with links, duplicate checking, and Twitter OAuth authentication.

methods.name: check_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific module type is enabled in the database configuration.

methods.name: format_feed_tweets
methods.description: Formats tweet text with HTML links and truncates if necessary based on the provided limit.

methods.name: replace_hashtags
methods.description: Replaces hashtags in tweet text with HTML anchor tags linking to Twitter hashtag searches.

methods.name: replace_users
methods.description: Replaces user mentions in tweet text with HTML anchor tags linking to Twitter user profiles.

methods.name: duplicate_check
methods.description: Checks for duplicate entries in the database based on tweet text and date.

methods.name: check_auth
methods.description: Performs Twitter OAuth authentication by obtaining request tokens and generating an authorization URL.
